title: StructraBuilds
description: Build Structures Like Items. Professional Minecraft plugin with build-as-item system, interactive ghost preview, real anti-dupe protection, and PostgreSQL persistence.
body:
# StructraBuilds — Build Structures Like Items

**StructraBuilds** is a professional-grade plugin for modern Paper (1.21.x) servers that introduces a powerful and scalable structure system.  
It allows administrators to deploy pre-built structures as interactive items, providing a smooth, safe, and optimized building experience.

Designed with performance, persistence, and anti-duplication security in mind, StructraBuilds is built for serious server environments.

---

## ✨ Features

- 🏗️ Deploy structures as in-game items  
- 👀 Interactive preview system before placement  
- 🔄 Move structures in 6 directions (X, Y, Z)  
- 🔁 90° rotation support  
- 🧱 Block Display Entity based preview (modern & lightweight)  
- 🗄️ PostgreSQL persistence  
- 🛡️ Real anti-duplication protection backed by database validation  
- ⚡ Optimized for Paper 1.21.x  

---

## 🎮 Perfect For

- SMP (Survival Multiplayer) servers  
- Creative build servers  
- RPG & adventure worlds  
- Event-based servers  
- Custom map deployment systems  

---

## 🚀 Why StructraBuilds?

StructraBuilds focuses on:

- Scalability  
- Data integrity  
- Performance optimization  
- Clean and intuitive interaction  

If you want a professional structure system with real persistence and anti-dupe protection, StructraBuilds delivers a reliable and modern solution.

---

**Version:** 1.x  
**Platform:** Paper 1.21.x  
**Database:** PostgreSQL
